snippet.title: 2XKO Console Sneak Peek
snippet.description:
2XKO is a free-to-play 2v2 fighting game from Riot Games, the studio behind VALORANT and League of Legends. Team up with a friend or fight solo on Xbox Series X|S and PlayStation 5 in January 2026. 2XKO is available now on PC, and was nominated for "Best Fighting Game" at The Game Awards 2025.

Caitlyn, the Sheriff of Piltover, is 2XKO’s upcoming champion. She’ll join the roster in January 2026.

#2XKO #RiotGames #TheGameAwards
